messages:
alex: FYI I'm starting onboarding for Umbra-7B-v1 (ResearchForge). License file attached in the repo. Quick question: the header says 'RF-NonComm-1.0' and there's a 'no commercial hosting' clause — can we serve this on Redwood Hosted API or Dedicated for paying customers?
maria: which exact clause are you reading? sometimes there are exceptions for embeddings/feature extraction.
siva: ping @legal-bot for the definitive read, but my 2c: if it forbids "commercial hosting" we probably can't include it in hosted endpoints. Dedicated might be allowed if the customer holds the weights.
liz: also need to check redistribution vs derivative weights after quant. ResearchForge sometimes allows 'model use' but disallows redistribution of converted weights.
legal-bot: Automated license summary (prelim): RF-NonComm-1.0 appears to allow "internal research and non-commercial use" and explicitly disallows "offering model-as-a-service". Redistribution of modified binaries is restricted. Code excerpt: "You may not offer the Model as a commercial service or redistribute converted model weights without express permission."
alex: thanks. So two sub-questions: 1) Can we offer embeddings from Umbra on hosted API? 2) Can we ship quantized weights to Dedicated customers (where Redwood would be distributing binaries)?
maria: embeddings as a product are still "service" in our terms. If license bars commercial service, hosted embeddings likely not ok. But maybe we can allow internal evals and research-only endpoints for free-tier devs?
siva: For Dedicated, our customers typically get a VM with the model preinstalled by us — that's distribution. If license forbids redistribution of converted weights, we can't ship the quantized files. Could we provide a conversion script and let customer run it on their side?
liz: ResearchForge often grants redistrib exception if attribution + linkback + non-sublicense clause are preserved. We should ask them.
legal-bot: Actionable next steps: 1) Request written clarification from ResearchForge on two points: commercial hosting (hosted API/embeddings) and redistribution of quantized/converted weights. 2) If redistribution disallowed, propose an alternative: offer a guided on-prem/Dedicated installer that runs conversion in-customer, with a checksum verification step (no binary transfer). 3) Keep a record in the model-onboarding ticket with license text and correspondence.
alex: I'll file the clarification email and cc @liz. Draft in #model-onboarding ticket.
maria: Also flag evals: we should not include Umbra in any public benchmarks or demo pages until we have permission.
siva: On quant experiments: do not commit any converted weights to our repos or S3 buckets that might be shared. Use local ephemeral endpoints for internal experiments.
liz: I'll prepare a suggested phrasing for the permission ask: short email + exact clause quote + proposed use cases (hosted embeddings, dedicated provisioning, redistribution of quantized weights).
alex: perfect, thanks everyone. I'll update thread when ResearchForge replies. :thumbsup:
